key_reasoning.reason: Touches the shared security util (new maskSecretsInText/maskSecretsDeep in src/utils/security.ts), the shared OtlpAgentAdapter base (limitPayload masking, droppedFields hook, raw drop, effort flattening) used by every OTLP adapter, the claude-code-otlp plugin and tool-fields (isSensitiveFilePath Read skip), and the copilot-cli-otlp plugin and usage module. Core shared utilities plus multiple adapters affected, bumped from L to XL.

Closest pattern is sanitizeValue/SENSITIVE_VALUE_PATTERNS in security.ts, but those are anchored whole-value matchers and do not cover secrets embedded in free text, so this is a divergence on a security-sensitive surface. New linear-time regex set (PEM, URL credentials, Authorization, JWT, Bearer, sk-, AWS, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, NAME=value) with ReDoS-bounded quantifiers on a hook hot path, 64 KB input cap and 32 depth cap. Missed or over-masked secrets cannot be recalled once sent to the analytics backend. Edge-case tables are covered by security.test.ts. Security red flag bumped from L to XL.
12 files changed per diffstat (517 insertions, 58 deletions): 5 source, 6 test and 1 doc, across src/utils, src/agents/core, and two plugin directories. Falls in the XL band (11-15).
